comparison.objective: Heat and solder a copper water joint without burning flux; candidate performs dry mechanical separation.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual torch and solder-wire control, thermal timing, precise feeding, and safe tool withdrawal versus granular-flow control and bimanual screen agitation.
comparison.success_condition: Requires ≥8.1 mm solder fed above liquidus, cooling below solidus, tools safely away, and no burnt flux, trapped wire, misdirected flame, or dropped tool. Candidate grades recovery mass, washer retention, spill/contamination/damage, and released support. No material rubric detail is missing.
comparison.reason: Thermal process control and solder wetting do not overlap meaningfully with mechanical screening.
